question: Does giving an AI trader a fixed neutral numerical feature summary, in addition to the same raw market data, change its trading behaviour and performance across BTC, ETH, and SOL?
classification: DESIGN PROPOSAL — trading engine implementation NOT yet authorized
instrument_wording: Synthetic USD-settled perpetual paper contract, marked and executed using Kraken {COIN}/USD spot-market OHLC data

market_data.coinbase_role: monitoring, alerting reference, and offline test fixtures ONLY — never a source for committed decisions, fills, exits, invalidation evaluation, or equity
market_data.completeness_policy: exactly 72 real, contiguous, fully closed Kraken hourly candles; exactly 40 real, contiguous, fully closed Kraken daily observations; complete real Kraken 1-minute coverage for every replay interval
market_data.missing_interval_policy: any missing interval invalidates the affected snapshot or replay: affected pairs record PAIR_ABORTED with DATA_UNAVAILABLE, no new decisions execute, and resting stop/target/liquidation/invalidation rules remain active only where complete 1-minute replay data exists; no interpolation, forward-fill, fabrication, or venue substitution of candles
market_data.execution_price: close of last completed 1m candle at boundary T (P_T)
market_data.beyond_catchup: INTEGRITY HALT C: that coin's V1 arena is terminated for the remainder of the run; last trustworthy state preserved; other coin arenas continue normally
market_data.gap_fill_wording: If a one-minute candle opens beyond a resting execution level, the fill occurs at that candle's opening price. For a protective stop or liquidation this may be worse than the trigger level; for a take-profit it may be better than the target level.

replay_gap_policy.rule: a replay gap preserves the last trustworthy watermark and sets CATCHUP_REQUIRED; no candles after an unresolved gap are processed; no interpolation or venue substitution; the coin's pairs abort DATA_UNAVAILABLE while its state cannot be brought exactly to T; only unresolved required history exceeding 10 hours terminates the coin's arena (Ruling 008.6)

common.messages: single user message (round prompt); validation retry appends assistant tool_use + tool_result acknowledgment + fixed rejection message
common.transport_note: transport_retries=3 means 1 initial attempt + 3 retries = 4 total transport attempts; the single validation-retry conversation obeys the same 4-attempt transport policy (Ruling 008.7)

claude-haiku-4-5-20251001.thinking: parameter omitted (model runs without extended thinking)

request_payloads.twin_parity: Raw and TA requests for the same model are byte-identical except the user prompt text

procedure: generate and archive all 18 first-attempt prompts before sending any model request
identical frozen prompts, state, and P_T regardless of response order
resolve commit/abort independently per matched pair
apply committed decisions logically at boundary T only after collection closes
one common post-T candle replay per coin
collection.global_collection_deadline: T+12 minutes, hard; transport retries must complete inside it
collection.concurrency_lock: preflight verifies 6-way concurrency against rate limits; the final value is locked before launch and cannot change during V1
collection.deadline_note: hard monotonic wall-clock deadline for the whole collection stage, anchored at collection start; results arriving after it never execute; retries may not begin unless their full budget fits inside it (Ruling 008.9)

atomic_unit: matched Raw/TA pair (same model, same coin); 9 independent pairs

pair_abort_semantics.meaning: zero DECISION-GENERATED state change at T for both twins
pair_abort_semantics.market_driven_exits_never_suspended: stops, targets, liquidation, and invalidation monitoring never pause because a discretionary round aborted or was skipped

terminal_account_policy.surviving_twin: continues receiving decisions and trading normally; never force-closed or frozen
terminal_account_policy.pair_status: PAIR_TERMINAL_SPLIT from the terminal event onward (missing side is an experimental outcome, not an infrastructure failure)
terminal_account_policy.metrics: post-terminal rounds excluded from paired behavioural metrics; both accounts' complete outcomes included in performance reporting; terminal timestamp and cause reported prominently

accounts.max_leverage: 5.0 — governs NEW or INCREASED exposure only (open, reversal, same-side increase): such decisions above 5x pre-decision equity are rejected (TARGET_EXCEEDS_MAX_LEVERAGE), never clamped. Exact holds (within the $10 executable tolerance) and reductions are always allowed even above 5x effective leverage; no forced deleveraging and no requirement to reduce below 5x (Ruling 006.1)
accounts.fee_rate: 0.0005 on every execution including stop/take-profit/liquidation fills and both reversal legs

accounting.arithmetic: decimal.Decimal for equity, P&L, fees, notional, quantity, prices; full source precision internally
accounting.quantity_rounding: round DOWN to per-coin qty_decimals at execution
accounting.display_rounding: presentation only; never feeds back into engine values

liquidation_contract.balance_variable: E = realized cash equity (Decimal): starting cash + all realized P&L - all fees to date; excludes unrealized P&L
liquidation_contract.unrealized: u(p) = q * (p - entry), with q the signed executed quantity (already rounded down to qty_decimals) and entry the Decimal average entry price
liquidation_contract.long_threshold: L = (q*entry - E) / ((1 - Decimal('0.02')) * q)   [q > 0; liquidate when p <= L]
liquidation_contract.short_threshold: L = (q*entry - E) / ((1 + Decimal('0.02')) * q)   [q < 0; liquidate when p >= L]
liquidation_contract.quantity_precision_note: thresholds are computed with the executed rounded-down q, so precision affects L exactly as it affects the position
liquidation_contract.gap_fill: if the 1m candle OPEN already satisfies the liquidation condition, fill at the open (worse price); otherwise fill at the threshold L
liquidation_contract.fee: Decimal('0.0005') * abs(q) * fill_price, charged on the liquidation execution
liquidation_contract.residual_equity: a liquidation MAY leave positive residual equity: the position is closed but the account continues trading
liquidation_contract.terminal_rule: permanent account closure ONLY when post-fee equity E' <= 0, floored to exactly 0

event_ordering.scope: every replayed 1-minute candle, evaluated in candle order
A_opening_gap: 1. if the account is already at or below maintenance margin at the candle open: liquidation at the open
2. else if the open has crossed the stop-loss: stop fill at the open
3. else if the open has crossed the take-profit: take-profit fill at the open

B_intracandle.long: downside protective exit = the HIGHER valid level of {stop_loss, liquidation threshold}, evaluated against the candle low; upside take-profit evaluated against the candle high
B_intracandle.short: upside protective exit = the LOWER valid level of {stop_loss, liquidation threshold}, evaluated against the candle high; downside take-profit evaluated against the candle low
B_intracandle.ambiguity: if both a protective exit and a take-profit are reachable inside the same candle and order is unknowable: the protective exit wins; record AMBIGUOUS_CANDLE_PROTECTIVE_FIRST

C_invalidation_observation.1m_intrabar: latch if the condition is satisfied anywhere in a candle in which the lifecycle existed at candle open; if the position also exits in that candle, record SAME_CANDLE_INVALIDATION_AND_EXIT; such an exit counts as no-longer-exposed for the discipline metric
C_invalidation_observation.1h_close: evaluate only at the completed hourly close; never trigger if the lifecycle ended before that close

event_ordering.D_lifecycle_end: after stop, target, liquidation, decision close, or reversal ends a lifecycle, later candles cannot trigger that lifecycle's invalidation

invalidation.lifecycle: set once at open-from-flat or reversal; immutable while the lifecycle is open (hold/increase/reduce/partial exits); close or reversal ends it
invalidation.trigger: inclusive comparison; first trigger latched permanently with timestamp, price, and candle reference
invalidation.post_trigger: no forced exit; next-round prompt shows the TRIGGERED block; behaviour recorded
invalidation.primary_discipline_metric: no longer exposed in the invalidated direction by the end of the account's next committed pair-round; stop, liquidation, reversal, or full close before that boundary qualifies; partial reductions reported descriptively, never as compliance

reliability_behavioural_outcome: which arm caused each pair abort
metrics.operative_decision: the executed corrected decision is the operative decision for behavioural analysis; formatting/semantic reliability reported separately, never hidden

denominators.direction_disagreement: pair-committed rounds where both twins were active and produced executable target positions
denominators.target_size_difference: compare target notional / twin's own pre-decision equity; report absolute difference in equity multiples
denominators.stop_target_usage: pair-committed rounds leaving the relevant account positioned
denominators.invalidation_response_rate: lifecycle invalidations that triggered early enough for at least one later committed decision opportunity before the experiment ended
denominators.turnover: cumulative executed notional / time-weighted average equity
denominators.exclusions: aborted, skipped, pre-launch, and post-terminal rounds never enter paired behavioural denominators; their counts and reasons are reported separately

metrics.statistics_policy: no p-values or claims of statistical significance in V1; report counts, rates, paired descriptive differences, and uncertainty limitations
metrics.feature_reference_frequency: descriptive: whether the thesis explicitly names a supplied feature (RSI, SMA, ATR, volume ratio, VWAP); mentioning a feature is never inferred to prove causation

normal_no_halt: temporary Kraken unavailability that recovers before replay integrity is lost

integrity_halts.A_hash_mismatch: code/config/prompt/schema hash mismatch => entire experiment halts PERMANENTLY; no same-run repair or resumption
integrity_halts.B_state_corruption: state corruption or non-atomic persistence failure => entire experiment halts PERMANENTLY
integrity_halts.C_replay_gap: >10 hours unrecoverable 1-minute history for one coin => that coin's arena terminated for the remainder of the run; last trustworthy state preserved; other arenas continue
integrity_halts.D_terminal_account: account reaches terminal zero => PAIR_TERMINAL_SPLIT (terminal_account_policy); experiment does NOT halt

halt_policy.no_discretionary_clearing: there is no mid-run human clearing of halts; any integrity termination is final for V1 and is reported

dashboard.visibility: public from the first committed boundary
required_elements: clearly labeled link to the archived pilot page
dashboard.pilot_label: PILOT / SYSTEM TEST / NOT VALID EXPERIMENTAL EVIDENCE

round_contract.duration: exactly 14 complete days = exactly 336 scheduled boundaries
round_contract.no_mid_run_changes: no extension, shortening, coin replacement, indicator/prompt/rule change based on observed results; missed rounds are never replaced
round_contract.T0_selection: first suitable :00 UTC boundary at least 24 hours after final mentor launch approval, which itself requires: all offline tests pass, 24-hour mock soak passes, production-payload preflight passes
round_contract.virtual_event_time: replay 1m to T -> freeze accounts at T -> freeze snapshots & P_T -> generate all 18 prompts -> collect/validate with bounded concurrency -> apply committed pairs at P_T -> one common post-T 1m replay per coin -> publish; wall-clock model latency is excluded from simulated market time

scheduler.missed_boundary: ROUND_SKIPPED for all unprocessed pairs; never executed retrospectively

persistence.code_branch: main pinned at approved launch tag; runtime never commits to it
persistence.runtime_branch: v1-runtime (state, prompt archive, attempt archive, logs, dashboard docs/)
persistence.integrity: every run verifies SHA-256 of code+prompts+schema+config against the launch manifest; mismatch => integrity halt A
persistence.recorded_code_hash: the approved launch commit, not the runtime-data commit

primary_behavioural: abs target-size difference in equity multiples
outcome_hierarchy.explicit_non_claim: V1 does not prove indicators improve profitability; performance results are descriptive

token_measurement: PENDING — count_tokens per model on 4 representative prompts (first-round raw/ta, mature raw/ta) during preflight; cost projection provisional until measured
arm_naming: scientific/public name for the treatment arm: 'Feature arm'; internal account-ID suffix remains _ta (legacy, permitted) to avoid migration churn

feature_pack.principle: the Feature arm may receive precomputed mathematical summaries, but never semantic judgments, trading guidance, recommended thresholds, or suggested actions

RSI14_H.calc: Wilder RSI(14): seed avg gain/loss = mean of first 14 close diffs of the visible 72-hour window, then avg=(avg*13+cur)/14

SMA20_H.calc: arithmetic mean of latest 20 completed hourly closes

SMA50_H.calc: arithmetic mean of latest 50 completed hourly closes

ATR14_H.calc: TR=max(h-l, abs(h-prev_c), abs(l-prev_c)); seed=mean of first 14 TRs; Wilder smoothing

CURRENT_VOLUME_H.calc: base-asset volume of the most recently completed Kraken hourly candle

MEAN_VOLUME_PREV24_H.calc: mean volume of the 24 completed hourly candles immediately preceding the latest candle (latest excluded)

VOLUME_RATIO_24.calc: latest completed hourly volume / mean of previous 24 completed hourly volumes

VWAP24_H.calc: typical=(high+low+close)/3; VWAP=sum(typical*volume)/sum(volume) over latest 24 completed hourly candles INCLUDING the latest

feature_pack.parameter_disclosure: RSI 14, SMA 20, SMA 50, ATR 14, and 24-hour volume/VWAP windows are predeclared design choices; they are not claimed to be universally optimal; no parameter will be changed during V1; V1 tests this exact fixed feature pack, not 'technical indicators in general'
feature_pack.scientific_limitation: V1 measures the effect of this specific predeclared numerical feature pack. It does not establish that these parameters are optimal or that technical indicators generally improve trading.

decision_schema_note: schemas/v1/decision.schema.json contains NO intended_horizon field; actual holding duration is measured from lifecycle open to close

parameters.note: authoritative machine-readable engine parameters; engine verifies its loaded constants against these at startup and halts on mismatch (Ruling 008.14)
